description: List your drops. With an account token: all LIVE drops attached to your account (across sessions and channels — manageable without managementToken), and the ones that expired less than a day ago, marked `expired: true` (their owner can reactivate them from My apps; dropyour_delete removes them), plus, under `delegated`, the apps OTHER accounts entrusted to you, each with your role (see dropyour_delegate). Anonymous: only the drops published during this MCP session. Management tokens are never stored server-side.
name: dropyour_list
title: List my drops
